mission_05: Excellent! You have successfully applied Box-Cox power transformations to normalize skewed data. You learned how scipy.stats.boxcox() automatically finds the optimal lambda parameter for each column and how to interpret the resulting lambda values. A lambda near 0 indicates a log-like transformation was optimal, while lambda near 0.5 suggests a square root transformation. Box-Cox is more flexible than fixed transformations because it adapts to each dataset. For data that may contain zeros or negative values, consider the Yeo-Johnson transformation which handles all real values.
